audit.why: Rumble 48.32% over 416 games. Rumble owns levels 1-3 against a melee Kayle and loses everything from her level-6 range spike onward — the chart (Rumble x3 then Kayle x4) matches both the win rate and Divine Ascent's scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment is treated as permanently available — 'she simply presses R when you all-in' — with no cooldown anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80. At rank 1 that is nearly three minutes between casts, which means there is a very large window in which Kayle is not unkillable at all. Without the number the advice reads as 'never fight her again'.
audit.corrected: Quote 160s at rank 1 and key the all-in to the window after she spends it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The early text says to 'burn her Crystallize shield if she has it'.
audit.why: Crystallize is an Anivia ability. Kayle has no shield in her kit at all — her defensive tools are Celestial Blessing (a heal, 15s) and Divine Judgment (invulnerability). Telling a Rumble to spend a trade popping a shield that does not exist is exactly the kind of instruction that loses the only good window in the matchup.
audit.corrected: No shield exists; the thing to trade around is Celestial Blessing's 15s heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Radiant Blast is never mentioned once.
audit.why: Radiant Blast is her only CC and it reduces the resistances of everyone it pierces — so a clean Q makes every follow-up auto and Starfire Spellblade hit measurably harder, on top of the slow that keeps you from disengaging. It is the single ability to sidestep in the matchup and the page does not name it.
audit.corrected: Named, with the slow-plus-resistance-shred effect stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing, despite the whole lane being a race against her scaling.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing heals her every 15 seconds and is what erases the chip damage Rumble's early lead is built on. Grievous Wounds on the first-item recall is what keeps the lead alive.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb tied to the first-item recall.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing lines anywhere in this matchup.
audit.why: Three numbers fix it: Divine Judgment 160s at rank 1, Celestial Blessing 15s, Starfire Spellblade 8s as her auto reset. Every piece of advice on the page can now be keyed to one of them.
audit.corrected: All three added across early, mid, spikes and whys.

edits.before: Two-item Kayle with Divine Judgment available is unkillable in a 1v1 — your only play is Equalizer across her escape path to delete her team around her.
edits.after: Two-item Kayle with Divine Judgment up is unkillable 1v1 — but it is 160s at rank 1, so the fight worth taking is the one right after she spends it.

edits.before: Scale into two items and use Divine Judgment to negate your all-in, then out-DPS you with her ranged form and Nashor's Tooth
edits.after: Bank Divine Judgment for your all-in — it is 160s at rank 1 — then out-DPS you with her ranged form and Nashor’s Tooth

edits.before: Land Equalizer across her path to zone her off fights even when you can no longer kill her in a straight duel
edits.after: Land The Equalizer across her path to zone her off fights once you can no longer kill her in a straight duel

edits.before: Kayle's first item (Nashor's Tooth or Kraken Slayer) makes her ranged DPS punishing in extended trades; avoid committing your W shield to poke trades you will not win.
edits.after: Her first item makes ranged DPS punishing in extended trades and Celestial Blessing heals it back every 15s — buy Oblivion Orb on that recall and save Scrap Shield for commits.

edits.before: Divine Judgment plus two items makes Kayle unkillable in the 1v1 window; she simply presses R when you all-in, survives your burst, and kills you with sustained ranged DPS.
edits.after: Divine Judgment plus two items makes her unkillable inside your all-in — she presses R, outlasts the burn and kills you. At 160s on rank 1, fight her only once it is spent.

edits.before: Kayle is genuinely melee before level 6 and has no real escape, so levels 1-3 are your best chance to punish her. Walk into her with Flamespitter active and force her to either take the damage or back off the wave — she cannot out-trade you in sustained melee contact at this stage. Reach the Danger Zone before you commit so your empowered Q does real damage, then land both Electro-Harpoon charges to keep her in the cone. Burn her Crystallize shield if she has it and keep the wave crashed under her tower so she is always at risk of your next trade pattern.
edits.after: Kayle is genuinely melee before level 6 and has no real escape, so levels 1-3 are your best chance to punish her. Walk into her with Flamespitter active and force her to either take the damage or back off the wave — she cannot out-trade you in sustained melee contact at this stage. Reach the Danger Zone before you commit so your empowered Q does real damage, then land both Electro Harpoon charges to keep her in the cone. She has no shield of any kind: her only answers are Celestial Blessing every 15 seconds and a Radiant Blast you can sidestep, so open your trade the moment the heal is spent.

edits.before: The moment Kayle hits level 6 she enters her ranged form and your Flamespitter suddenly cannot reach her unless you walk forward into her auto range. She will begin kiting you backward, poking you with empowered Starfire autos, and only using Divine Judgment when you actually all-in. Play around your Equalizer from here — use it to zone her off the wave, deny her from following a roam, or threaten her into backing away from CS. Do not burn your W shield on poke; save it for when you actually commit to a trade so you can absorb her burst and get your Flamespitter onto her. She cannot kill you easily either, so the goal is to stay relevant on the map while denying her CS lead.
edits.after: The moment Kayle hits level 6 she enters her ranged form and your Flamespitter cannot reach her unless you walk into her auto range. She kites backward, pokes with Starfire Spellblade — an 8-second auto reset that scales off your missing health — and saves Divine Judgment for a real all-in. The one thing that must not land clean is Radiant Blast: it slows you and strips your resistances, so everything after it hits far harder. Play around The Equalizer from here — zone her off the wave, deny a roam, threaten her off CS. Do not burn Scrap Shield on poke; save it for the commit. She cannot kill you easily either, so stay relevant on the map and deny the CS lead.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Divine Judgment 160/120/80: bait it, then take the next three minutes. - Celestial Blessing 15s is the heal your chip fights. - Radiant Blast strips resistances — never eat it clean.
